title: Forty percent bonus—everyone is sharing it
scenario: A sponsored post uses your loyalty-program branding and promotes a 40% points-transfer bonus. Several travel accounts you follow have reposted it, but the destination domain is unfamiliar.

answers.A: Trust the offer if several established travel accounts shared it and the comments show successful transfers.
answers.B: Open your bank or loyalty app directly and look for the same transfer promotion there.
answers.C: Use support chat inside the official app and ask whether the promotion is active.

explanation: Social proof can be bought, copied or amplified by compromised accounts. The offer should exist where your points already live.
